summary.text: Sarah Slattery is the Democratic nominee for Secretary of State. A professional chef and small-business owner from Cass County, she serves on the Plattsmouth Library Board and Plattsmouth Bridge Commission and campaigns on public trust in the office and accessible voting.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Cass County; opened a vineyard and tasting room there in 2008 and has run small businesses for 18 years.
Serves on the Plattsmouth Library Board and the Plattsmouth Bridge Commission.
